data.name: Ocean
data.description: Ocean Visions is a US-based science-focused nonprofit that catalyzes research, road maps, field trials, and policy frameworks for marine carbon dioxide removal (mCDR). It runs the Launchpad accelerator, publishes an mCDR Ecosystem Database and Field Trial Database, and commissions work such as an Environmental Impact Assessment Framework for mCDR being developed by Fugro. The organization is a convener and facilitator, not a CDR supplier itself.
